title: Item Challenge
description: Give your server a collective goal: collect a set amount of any item before the in-game days run out. Track progress in real time through a boss bar, deposit your items in one command, and see who contributed the most.
body:
Item Grind Challenge gives your server a collective goal: collect a set number of a chosen item within a limited number of in-game days. Every player contributes to the same counter, and the progress is always visible through a boss bar.

**How it works**

An admin starts a challenge with a single command. From that point, players collect items the normal way — mining, farming, killing mobs — and deposit them using /challenge depot. The boss bar updates in real time and shows the current day, the progress, and the percentage.

**Features**

Boss bar with live progress, day counter, and percentage /challenge depot to instantly deposit all matching items from your inventory /challenge info for detailed stats including a per-day estimate to reach the goal /challenge top to see who contributed the most Configurable commands executed on win or fail (give rewards, run broadcasts, etc.) Progress saved to disk and restored on server restart Item names displayed in each player's own client language Full language support: English and French included, add your own by copying a lang file

**Commands**

Command Permission Description /challenge start <item> <goal> <days> itemchallenge.admin Start a new challenge /challenge stop itemchallenge.admin Stop the current challenge /challenge depot itemchallenge.use Deposit items from your inventory /challenge info itemchallenge.use Show progress details /challenge top itemchallenge.use Show top contributors Language

The plugin ships with English and French. To switch, change language: en to language: fr in config.yml. To add your own language, copy lang/en.yml, translate the values, and point the config to your new file.
